prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: high-resolution transparent product reveal image for a premium audio and neurotechnology website, landscape 3:2 canvas.
Input images: Image 1 is the exact existing CYMBA earbud identity and geometry reference. Image 2 is only a reference for the graphite and muted champagne finish, fine studio lighting and overall premium photographic quality.
Primary request: Photograph ONE of these same wired CYMBA earbuds from a new three-quarter INNER-SIDE viewpoint, rotated toward its inward-facing side so the user can understand the contact wing, ear tip and cable connection. This is the reverse/detail angle complement to the front-facing hero. Do not simply mirror the reference or reproduce its front-facing circular disc view.
Camera and composition: A close, beautifully engineered product study. See the inner housing as the main surface, with the circular radially brushed outer faceplate receding at image-left, seen partially edge-on rather than as a large full circle. The curved soft contact wing rises toward the upper-left/upper-centre with its two small champagne contact pads clearly visible. The grey silicone tip projects toward image-right and somewhat toward the camera, visibly and correctly seated on a short acoustic nozzle at the REAR of the inner housing, directly opposite the circular metal outer faceplate. The inner housing smoothly bridges disc, wing, and ear tip. Cable strain relief emerges from the bottom and a dark braided cable sweeps down and toward the lower-right edge. Preserve one small recessed black optical window where present but do not add glowing sensors or label functions.
Frame the whole single earpiece centrally and generously at around 70 percent of canvas width and 83 percent of height, including the entire contact wing and tip. Keep clear alpha around all body edges; cable can taper naturally to the lower-right edge. Distinct large silhouette, no plinth or surrounding objects. Earbud angle should feel physically grounded in the studio lighting, not like an exploded assembly.
Material and lighting: exact graphite housing, fine brushed circular metal, satin grey silicone, understated champagne rim and pads, black braided cable. Soft neutral key light from upper-left, controlled grazing edge light defining dark surfaces, high-fidelity fine material texture, deep charcoal shadow detail. Match the hero's expensive restrained consumer-tech photography. Clear readable form on a dark charcoal webpage; no harsh white rim or artificial glow.
Constraints: exact existing product design, ONE earbud only, no added parts or changes to contact shapes, no extra tips, no disconnected components, no impossible geometry, no extra controller, no stand, no hands, no people, no diagrams, no text or symbols, no logo, no watermark. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background with alpha, no checkerboard rendered into the image, no grey/black/white rectangle, no floor plane or backdrop. Only the product remains opaque.
